answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond that is slashed when its actions are proven to violate a shared rule, while rewards accrue only after useful work is independently verified. A sybil attacker can create many names, but cannot multiply influence cheaply: every name locks real capital, and coordinated fake work risks losing it. The bond can be held on an island ledger, with cedar and ferrous goods accepted only if their value is verifiably priced and enforceable.
